{"category_edits":[{"category":"hyperparameter_tuning","rationale":"Across all four category models, couple a lower learning rate of 7e-4 with dropout 0.3 and weight decay 1e-5 to moderate updates and regularize the normalized tied embeddings and narrower feed-forward layers. Existing checkpoint metadata and predictor construction remain compatible. Preserve all other hyperparameters, formulas, seeds and training limits.","edits":[{"find":"DROPOUT_RATE  = float(os.environ.get("BERT4REC_DROPOUT", "0.2"))
LR            = float(os.environ.get("BERT4REC_LR", "1e-3"))
WEIGHT_DECAY  = float(os.environ.get("BERT4REC_WD", "0.0"))","replace":"DROPOUT_RATE  = float(os.environ.get("BERT4REC_DROPOUT", "0.3"))
LR            = float(os.environ.get("BERT4REC_LR", "7e-4"))
WEIGHT_DECAY  = float(os.environ.get("BERT4REC_WD", "1e-5"))"}]}],"change_summary":"Jointly tune learning rate, dropout and weight decay for all four independent BERT4Rec category models."}
